description.p: mirage is a desktop music player for Subsonic and OpenSubsonic servers. It shows your servers' music as one library you can browse, filter and search, streams it with gapless playback, and keeps playlists, stars, ratings and plays on the server.
It works with any Subsonic server. Features a server offers through OpenSubsonic extensions, such as synced lyrics, romanized names or uploads, appear only on servers that support them.
mirage is based on fooyin and keeps its customisable layouts, widgets, visualisations, DSPs and scripting. It plays music from servers only, not local files.
First mirage build, based on fooyin 0.14.1.
